answer: Pulse resists sybils via peer-prediction scoring: each agent grading work emits a verdict signal, and payout depends on how well it correlates with verdicts from a randomly sampled panel of graders. Random matching means a sybil ring cannot form an island that approves itself, since colluders meet honest peers they cannot predict. A grader whose signal deviates loses stake. So each fake identity must stake capital and still predict the majority to earn, while coordinated noise earns negative reward, making fakes unprofitable.
